notes: Two cameras: no more clip-length cap and no more auto-stop. Recording runs until you tap Stop video, hold 2 fingers, turn a camera off, or disconnect. The old 10-second cap and the 'you left the frame' auto-stop are gone. Two cameras: Stop now really stops BOTH cameras. The host sends Stop again if the second camera doesn't answer, sends a heartbeat while recording, and a closing connection stops a running recording — the second camera no longer keeps rolling after you ended the video on the main. Arm swings are now a real activity: the camera scores your arm action (elbow angle, hands on your own side, hand height) instead of reading arm practice as rest with no reps. A clip where the camera can't see your full body now says 'Couldn't score' instead of 0%. Your recording's best frame now goes to AI Photo on its own — with markers and You vs Pro — and the two-camera replay has a 'Send best frame to AI Photo' button. Scans tell you when they're done: 'Analysis complete' speaks out loud, and the new 'Notify me when scans finish' button can send a device notification too (tap it once to allow). Replay now has slow motion (0.25× / 0.5× / 1×) plus AI moments — tap a red 'Needs work' or green 'Looks good' marker to jump both clips to that moment. Uploaded clips keep playing after analysis with their own moments. The rig is smooth now: it glides between camera frames at your screen's refresh rate (up to 120 fps) instead of jumping, with a live 'Rig drawing ~X fps · pose ~Y/sec' line. It also clears itself if the feed freezes or goes black, and hands no longer draw alone on a face close-up (that was the tangled knot).
